analysis.summary: The 'Infrastructure list' referenced by this issue is the infrastructureServices array in services.seed.ts (Service records with repositoryTable OTHER_SERVICES), not the unrelated Infrastructure deployment-target model that shares the name. Its provider/description fields are stale relative to the SECASSURED source, and the same create-only seedServices() limitation found in #5 applies here: edits to the seed array alone won't reach already-seeded databases.
analysis.details: This is effectively the same underlying mechanism as #5 (both are Service records seeded via services.seed.ts) applied to a different data subset (the ~20-entry 'Table 2' infrastructure/use-case services rather than the 44-entry INTACT toolbox list). Because #6's category-taxonomy refresh and #7's service-entry refresh both hang off the same categorySlug values, #7 should land after #6 to avoid referencing categories that #6 is simultaneously renaming/removing.

decision_record.root_cause: The infrastructureServices array ('Table 2') inside services.seed.ts holds stale provider/description values for Infrastructure-type services; the same create-only seeding limitation as #5 prevents refreshed data from reaching already-seeded databases, and it shares categorySlug values with #6's taxonomy refresh.

selected_option.name: Combine with #5's status/update mechanism
